thesis: The speakers argue that while raw individual talent is common even at the highest professional levels, great teams are rare and necessary to overcome challenges that individuals cannot achieve alone. They contend that teamwork is more sustainable and enjoyable than relying solely on innate talent, as it allows individuals to spar with others to refine their skills and extend their longevity in their careers.
